about: 2.48: when NSE F&O trades (bullets, dated). regular = a normal day's session; holidays come from rules/health.json plus extra_holidays here; special_sessions = extra sessions on non-trading days (Diwali Muhurat) or changed timings, with the exchange circular. live/session.py reads this: the live scanner starts and stops by it, and no alert or paper trade is made outside a session. paper_in_special: paper trades during special sessions (off: a one-hour symbolic session, thin and unusual).

special_sessions.name: Diwali Muhurat trading
special_sessions.source: NSE circular FAOP76940 (142/2026): F&O pre-open 14:05, normal market 14:20-15:40
